notes: Score = probability of the known-correct output (1.0 is perfect). ZNE is reported as null when added noise did not lower the score (zne_ok false). ci95 = bootstrap interval over shots only. GHZ score counts all-0/all-1 outcomes, so it detects bit flips but not loss of entanglement. Layout 'vendor' is chosen from IBM's reported numbers only. entanglement: GHZ fidelity from population plus parity oscillation; F > 0.5 (whole interval) means genuine entanglement. rb: randomized benchmarking on the selected and vendor chains, run simultaneously (includes crosstalk); per-gate errors divide the error per Clifford by the average gate count per Clifford (approximate). equal_budget: ZNE intervals when it gets a third of the shots per noise level, i.e. the same total as raw. Two-qubit gate errors used for chain selection are measured by repeated-gate decay (includes crosstalk from parallel edges); vendor values are only a fallback.
